name: Sunny Sharma
summary: Full-stack engineer who builds AI-powered products end to end, from PostgreSQL schemas and Python/FastAPI services to rich React interfaces. As a Full-Stack Developer Intern at Namaah Pvt. Ltd., I single-handedly built two production modules of Atlas, an AI film-production platform: Slate, a collaborative review and production workspace, and the Storyboard Studio, with AI shot generation and in-browser MP4 animatic export. Before that I shipped Java/Spring Boot and MERN products, including an AI applicant-tracking system, a RAG-backed tax platform and a real-time collaborative classroom, so I'm at home across Python, Java and JavaScript stacks.
shortBio: I build AI-powered products end to end, from schema to UI. At Namaah I'm building Atlas, an AI film-production platform, where I single-handedly shipped its review workspace and storyboard studio.
